about: THE WORKED EXAMPLE (jobs/build-the-grading-machine-2026-11-15 part 5). The Tactics board on Discover -> Tactics: clear of the fixed tab bar at rest on every card (TC-INV-08e), one width on every card (TC-INV-08k), with both tabs proven reached (TC-INV-08d). Gate 78 is run whole and unchanged (about 6 minutes a try); only its 08d, 08e and 08k lines are graded, in the eight situations gate 78 itself drives. NOT COVERED, said rather than implied: gate 78 drives no laptop width and no skin, so neither is a situation here; and gate 78 does not assert the board's horizontal place, so a board pushed sideways off the edge is invisible to these checks (measured with a probe patch at batch 12, BLIND; recorded on the job, not shipped as a break here because this example must prove the machine on a gate that sees its breaks).

breaks.why: the board is 48px narrower on the 12th motif (Decoy) than on the others, so it jumps between cards

breaks.name: board-under-the-tab-bar
breaks.why: the cap is 400px larger than the room, so the board runs under the tab bar and past the screen
